_comment: ONE ROW OF MJ CORE DATA, AND THE ONLY ONE THIS APP SEEDS. It exists because a seeded pipeline needs
a company to link to (PipelineCompany), and a pipeline linked to no company is one no deal can use —
an app with no usable pipeline is one where nobody can create a deal.
WHY A DIRECTORY RATHER THAN `?create` ON THE PIPELINE LOOKUP. That was tried first and it is the
syntax MJ documents for exactly this. It failed inside the push's own layer — `Failed to auto-create
MJ: Companies: Error executing SQL` — while `EXEC __mj.spCreateCompany` with the same arguments
succeeds when called directly, so the fault is in the auto-create path and not in the data. A
declared directory with declared ordering does the same job through the path every other row in this
repo takes, and fails legibly if it ever cannot.
A DEPLOYMENT SHOULD RENAME OR REPLACE THIS. It is a placeholder that makes the app usable, not a
claim about anyone's business. scripts/seed-demo-data.sh links the seeded pipelines to the local
dev companies and retires this company's links, so a development host never really uses it.
